text: Invited to give a guest lecture on Trustworthy AI at William & Mary.
Attending EMNLP 2026 in Budapest, Hungary and presenting our paper, Toward Cultural Alignment: Human-Centered Evaluation of Multimodal AI Stories Across Five African Communities.
Our paper, Toward Cultural Alignment: Human-Centered Evaluation of Multimodal AI Stories Across Five African Communities, was accepted to Findings of EMNLP 2026.
Marked five years at Microsoft Research Africa.
Awarded the Schlumberger Foundation Faculty for the Future Fellowship, supporting my PhD research in Computer Science at the University of the Witwatersrand, Johannesburg.
Co-hosted the 7th AfricaNLP Workshop themed Multilingual Multimodal NLP at EACL 2026 in Rabat, Morocco.
Presented Reasoning Beyond Labels: Measuring LLM Sentiment in Low-Resource, Culturally Nuanced Contexts at AfricaNLP at EACL 2026.
Recognized as a WiDS High Impact Ambassador by WiDS Worldwide for sustained leadership advancing women in data science and AI.
Joined the AfricaNLP workshop organizing team as Communications Chair, supporting workshop communications and community engagement.
Our paper IrokoBench: A New Benchmark for African Languages in the Age of Large Language Models received an Outstanding Paper Award at NAACL 2025.
Beyond Metrics: Evaluating LLMs' Effectiveness in Culturally Nuanced, Low-Resource Real-World Scenarios accepted at the AfricaNLP workshop, ACL 2024.
Two papers accepted at NAACL 2024: MEGAVERSE and AfriMTE/AfriCOMET.
Can Large Language Models Support Medical Facilitation Work? presented at AfriCHI 2023.
MEGA: Multilingual Evaluation of Generative AI accepted at EMNLP 2023.
Led and co-organized the WiDS Kenya and WiDS Africa conferences, coinciding with the global WiDS Stanford conference.
Led and co-organized the Women in Data Science WiDS Datathon workshops.
Attended EMNLP 2022 in Abu Dhabi, UAE. My first in-person conference.
Recognized by WiDS Worldwide at Stanford University as a top Ambassador promoting data science in Kenya and Africa.
Language Patterns and Behaviour of the Peer Supporters in Multilingual Healthcare Conversational Forums accepted at LREC 2022.
A Few Thousand Translations Go a Long Way! accepted at NAACL 2022.
Became WiDS Kenya Ambassador, representing Microsoft Research Africa in promoting WiDS across Kenya and Africa.
Joined Microsoft Research Africa in Nairobi, Kenya.
Joined the Institute for Applied Computational Science (IACS) at Harvard University as a Research Intern.
Joined Data Science Africa summer school and workshop.
